deduped.element: Back to inbox arrow and English message text
deduped.check: BC-3 / CRAP alignment: back arrow stays left-facing in RTL and inherited direction reorders English punctuation
deduped.fix: Mirror directional navigation and isolate content direction per message/email identifier; keep the surrounding RTL layout.

deduped.element: Account1 prefix and repeated setup explanation
deduped.check: BC-18 / CRAP proximity: mobile header spends extra height on an internal account ID before correspondence
deduped.fix: Remove the internal account-number prefix; retain only setup guidance that helps the operator choose an action.

deduped.check: BC-2 / WCAG1.4.3: measured text contrast below4.5; status text4.35 light, No chats2.66 light/4.06 dark, group labels3.68 light
deduped.fix: Remove excessive text opacity and use readable inherited foreground treatment on the actual backgrounds; remeasure both themes.

deduped.element: terminal new-tab and status alert buttons
deduped.check: BC-2 / Button accessible name: actual ARIA tree exposes unnamed icon controls; source lacks labels
deduped.fix: Reuse the existing translated action names as accessible labels; retain visible keyboard focus and verify the empty alert state.

deduped.element: access token field and invalid-token error
deduped.check: BC-1 / Input labels and validation: actual DOM has no persistent label, aria-invalid, describedBy or live error semantics
deduped.fix: Add a visible associated token label, validation association and announced error while preserving existing login behavior.

deduped.surface: Ops editing across Settings language change
deduped.check: BC-3/BC-9 | wrong-state-rendered: separate settings-tab language change remounts workspace and loses unsaved reply without confirmation
deduped.fix: Keep the already-mounted subtree during subsequent locale message loads; retain initial boot guard and backend isolation. Test reply/note/review and rerun actual CLI locale transition.

deduped.check: BC-12 | content ambiguity: generic no-receipt implication remains alongside an actual accepted provider receipt
deduped.fix: Condition explanatory copy on delivery state so accepted receipt, denial and unknown each have one consistent explanation.
